assign.outcome:
**The rail is a shared surface, and now it says so.** A short `Sharing it` section in [ext/drawer readme](/framework/ext/drawer/), the full record in [Sharing the rail](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/decisions/), and the measurement that backs the first bullet.

- 1,700 rebuilds of the rail contents (about 61k elements, 34k listeners), GC forced via CDP: nodes 10664 unchanged, listeners 3821 unchanged, heap +0.03 MB. Fill-and-empty collects cleanly.
- Four rules for a second caller: fill do not hold (and unbind anything you subscribe); dock() once then only fill; re-announce your subject instead of drawer.refresh(); claim your own clicks with stopPropagation.
- The Who uses this table gained the ext/Panel row it was missing.

![](shot.png)

Left alone: the ext/layout ownership bug itself - one permanent click listener on a shared rail - which already has a proposal at ai/2026-08-19/panel-bar-sweep/.
